reviews.text:
This is a very kind hospital.
It seems to be quite popular with dogs.

Although it's always busy, he is a very trustworthy doctor.
His surgical skills are truly amazing, and the other staff members always have a smile on their face and are really kind and pleasant to deal with.
I think the prices are reasonable considering the location. My family's lives have been saved so many times, and we are so grateful.
Vet was quite kind and helpful. Also spoke English which made it easier to communicate.

The best vet I have been to in my 15 years of raising my pug. Dr. Nobu is kind, caring and professional. He always goes the extra mile in reassuring us even if it's difficult news. I honestly feel like he cares deeply about my dog and his wellbeing. I've been to many vets globally with Frank but this vet is by far our favorite. We commute to this vet for a reason. Thank you.

I started going to this veterinary clinic after a friend recommended it, and now it's a place I truly trust. The doctor's diagnoses are accurate, and he explains things concisely, but behind his words, I always feel a deep compassion for animals. He carefully addresses even the smallest changes in my pet, and I can always entrust my pet to him with peace of mind.
The nurses are also cheerful, kind, and gentle, which makes me feel relaxed as well.
The warm atmosphere that permeates the entire clinic is naturally felt even in the waiting room, creating a space where pet owners can chat with smiles on their faces.
I am truly grateful to have a place where I can entrust my beloved family member with such confidence. I want to continue going there for many years to come.

I realized that online reviews aren't reliable. The prices are reasonable, but the treatment is only so-so, and there are limitations because there's only one doctor. They don't take appointments, so it's convenient for vaccinations, heartworm prescriptions, and really minor illnesses, but there are definitely better hospitals out there.

I went to see him for a skin condition, but it didn't get better, so I went to another hospital and was misdiagnosed.
I heard from people around me that he doesn't do well with skin conditions.
The director is socially awkward, so even when I ask questions he doesn't respond and it's difficult to talk to him.
Tests for chronic conditions, which were required at other hospitals, are only performed if I request them.
I have epilepsy, and was told that the dosage is working as long as I don't have seizures, so I didn't need to worry about the results of my blood tests. After my medication was reduced, I had a seizure.
The only thing I can praise is that the medical costs are not expensive.
Great experience on first visit. Went in without an appointment, staff are very kind and efficient. Priced reasonably, the vet spoke excellent English and was also very kind and professional. 👍👍 …

Brought my two cats in on a Friday evening appointment. The staff were very kind and Dr. Nobu was very caring as he checked both my boys. I have a 12 year old cat who can be grumpy but Dr. Nobu and the nurse only got a few grumbles from him which made my heart at ease. I emailed to setup an appointment and communication was great.
